comment: Declared production TLS posture per edge. These hostnames are platform-assigned (cloudfront.net, vercel.app, netlify.app) - none is a domain this project controls. That has a concrete consequence recorded in config/security/post-quantum-policy.json: a TLS 1.3 *minimum* cannot be enforced from this repository, because ACM validation requires control of the domain and the protocol floor is set by each provider. What IS enforceable is that no edge regresses into legacy TLS and that TLS 1.3 stays available. The probe gates exactly those two things.

requirements.comment: A TLS 1.3 minimum is deliberately NOT required. Every edge below is measured at a TLS 1.2 floor with 1.3 available; requiring 1.3 here would be a gate no real edge could satisfy, which is the same silent-pass as skipping the check, only dressed as a failure. Hybrid PQ key exchange is measured per edge but not required globally: selection is provider-controlled, and one edge is known to negotiate the classical fallback. Set requirePqcHybridKex=true only after every measured edge selects X25519MLKEM768.

edges.label: backend edge (CloudFront)
edges.note: Fronts the backend API (AURA_BACKEND_ORIGIN). MinimumProtocolVersion is not honoured on CloudFrontDefaultCertificate distributions - CloudFront enforces its own 1.2 floor. Verified by probing, not by reading config. Measured 2026-11: pure X25519MLKEM768 handshake accepted.

edges.label: storefront (Netlify)
edges.note: Measured 2026-11: pure X25519MLKEM768 rejected; ordered X25519MLKEM768:X25519 fallback accepted and selected X25519. Provider currently does not select hybrid on this edge.
